summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The State Street SPDR MSCI EAFE Fossil Fuel Reserves Free ETF (EFAX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI EAFE ex Fossil Fuels index. The fund tracks a subset of the MSCI EAFE Index that excludes companies that own fossil fuel reserves. EFAX was launched on Oct 24, 2016 and is issued by State Street.

holdings.infoBox: EFAX is an equity ETF with a total of 644 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 3.40%, HSBC Holdings at 1.73%, Roche Holding AG at 1.51%, Novartis AG at 1.34%, and AstraZeneca at 1.26%.
